_comment: PROPOSED recurring discovery schedule. NOT CREATED. Requires CEO approval because it consumes Claude usage and runs unattended.
name: Rainmaker weekly talent discovery

mechanism_options.description: Claude Code scheduled task that starts a fresh cloud session in this repository's environment and runs the weekly prompt.
mechanism_options.prompt_summary: Run the weekly discovery queries, write new candidates to data/raw/r<N>/, re-validate top 20, run the pipeline, summarize reports/weekly_intel_<date>.md. Never contact anyone.
requirements: private storage for data/ (not the public website repo)
mechanism_options.cost: Claude usage only; no paid APIs

mechanism_options.description: On a workstation with Claude Code installed and logged in.
mechanism_options.crontab_line: 42 5 * * 2 cd /path/to/rainmaker && python3 scripts/weekly_discovery.py --plan && claude -p "$(cat checkpoints/weekly_prompt_$(date +%F).md)" --permission-mode acceptEdits >> logs/weekly_cron.log 2>&1
